email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — 5,000+ trophies, war-focused, built different
email.body:
We are POAP KINGS, a Clash Royale clan built around Clan Wars, real recognition, and long-term memory.

Our top members are pushing 14,000 trophies. Our donation leaders — TDuck, Chanco, Vijay — are consistently putting up 400+ cards a week. We track all of it.

Every season, our top war contributor earns a free Pass Royale. We also issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records — for seasons, milestones, and meaningful clan moments. Most clans do not do that.

We want active players who show up for war, donate to clanmates, and want to be part of something that actually keeps score.

Requirement: 5,000 trophies. Everything else is at https://poapkings.com

reddit.title: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — War-focused, POAP culture, Free Pass Royale program [5000]
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS | #J2RGCRVG | 41/50 members | 5,000 trophies required**

---

**Quick stats**
- Combined trophies: 415,000+
- Weekly donations: 5,440
- Clan war trophies: 540
- Three members at the 14,000 trophy cap

---

**Who we are**

POAP KINGS is a war-focused clan with a builder culture behind it. We were founded about four months ago and have been growing with intention — not just filling slots.

We track Clan Wars participation seriously. Our season war leaders are putting up 7,000 to 9,000+ fame across four weeks. We expect members to use their war decks on battle days and set boat defenses during practice days. We do not guilt-trip anyone for real life, but we do keep score.

What makes us unusual: we issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records — for seasons and milestones. Most clans do not do that. We also run a Free Pass Royale program: the top war contributor each season earns a free pass, funded by clan leadership.

---

**Standout members**

- **Vijay** — Co-Leader, 14,000 trophies, 398 donations this week
- **TDuck** — 430 donations, consistent war presence at 12,800+ trophies

---

**What we want**

- 5,000+ trophies
- Active in Clan Wars — use your decks, show up for battle days
- Donating to clanmates regularly
- Real life comes first, but presence matters

---

Find us at https://poapkings.com or search clan tag #J2RGCRVG in-game.
